name: CloudCrane API
description: Call a deployed tool over REST or MCP, read a workspace as you build it over the workspace MCP, and receive signed webhooks. Every tool's exact input schema is its own: read it from the tool's `schema` endpoint, or from MCP's `tools/list`. Send a W3C `traceparent` header to have a call join your own trace: the `traceresponse` header names our span in it, and every reply carries an `X-Request-Id`.
